title: Finance & Metrics
subtitle: Know your numbers. Own your narrative.
description: You do not need to be a CFO to run a financially healthy business. You need to understand nine numbers and one story. This module gives you the frameworks to know whether your unit economics work, how long your runway is, what metric defines your growth, and how to present your financial reality to investors in a way that builds confidence rather than questions. Finance is not accounting it is the language of business decisions.
